guesses.reason: Short dense coat with brown mackerel tabby striping on the back and head over a large white chest, belly, muzzle blaze and paws is the classic random-bred bicolor tabby pattern.
The legs look notably short relative to the body in this crouched pose, which could hint at a short-legged Munchkin influence, though posture may exaggerate it.
Very large, tall, wide-set ears and a fairly fine, wedge-leaning face give a slightly Oriental look.

breed.appearance: A slim, small-framed short-haired cat with a brown mackerel tabby coat on the back, sides, tail, and top of the head, and bright white on the chest, belly, lower face, and all four paws. The face has a white inverted-V blaze running up between the eyes to the forehead with a tabby patch over the nose bridge, a warm caramel-brown wash beside a pink nose and on the chin, very long white whiskers, and round pale green-gold eyes. Her ears are strikingly large, tall, and pointed with pale inner fur, and her legs appear short with tabby-striped upper legs ending in white mitten paws.
breed.fun_fact: Tabby-and-white cats like Savannah are one-of-a-kind, since no two ever share the exact same pattern of stripes and white patches!
